nodes.description: Address of the YieldTokenFactory; set to msg.sender in the constructor and used as the delegatecall target by mint and burn.
LP token address assigned in initialize; mint reads its balanceOf for the minted amount.
Arbitrary bytes supplied by the factory in initialize and forwarded inside the delegatecall payloads of mint and burn.
Total supply of yield tokens, increased in _mint and decreased in _burn.
Mapping from account to yield token balance updated by _mint, _burn and _transfer.
Nested mapping owner=>spender=>amount read and reduced in transferFrom and written by _approve.
Per-owner permit nonces consumed when building the permit digest.
Reentrancy guard flag (1 = unlocked) used by the lock modifier on mint and burn.
EIP-712 domain separator used in the permit digest.
YieldTokenFactory address used to resolve pid to yield token.
One-time initializer restricted to the factory; sets lpToken, data, name and symbol and performs external calls to the pair tokens.
Internal mint that credits totalSupply and balanceOf using SafeMathUniswap.
Internal burn that debits balanceOf and totalSupply using SafeMathUniswap.
Private helper that writes the allowance mapping and emits Approval.
Private helper that moves balances between accounts.
External approve that approves spender on behalf of msg.sender.
External transfer from msg.sender to a recipient.
External transferFrom that decrements allowance unless infinite.
EIP-2612 permit that validates a deadline against block.timestamp and recovers a signer with ecrecover before approving.
Locked mint that reads the lp token balance and delegatecalls the factory deposit routine.
Locked burn that delegatecalls the factory withdraw routine for the contract's own yield token balance.
External deposit entrypoint that resolves the yield token by pid and deposits.
Internal deposit pulling LP tokens with safeTransferFrom and calling SushiYieldToken.mint(to).
External withdraw entrypoint that resolves the yield token by pid and withdraws.
Internal withdraw pulling yield tokens with safeTransferFrom and calling SushiYieldToken.burn(to).
Permit-based deposit entrypoint guarded by the ensure(deadline) timestamp modifier.
Internal helper that calls permit on an arbitrary token address for msg.sender.
Internal view that resolves pid to a non-zero yield token address through the factory.
Caller-controlled address used as fund source, allowance owner and permit owner.
Timestamp used for deadline checks in permit and in the ensure modifier.
Low-level delegatecall to the factory address inside SushiYieldToken.mint with signature deposit(bytes,uint256,address).
Low-level delegatecall to the factory address inside SushiYieldToken.burn with signature withdraw(bytes,uint256,address).
Signature recovery in permit; the recovered address is compared with the claimed owner.
Low-level token.call in TransferHelper.safeApprove/safeTransfer/safeTransferFrom used for ERC20 interaction and possible arbitrary external calls.
Low-level ETH transfer call in TransferHelper.safeTransferETH.

edges.reason: msg.sender is the account whose LP tokens are pulled in by safeTransferFrom inside _deposit.
msg.sender is the account whose yield tokens are pulled in inside _withdraw.
msg.sender allowance is read and decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender becomes the allowance owner in approve.
msg.sender is passed as the permit owner to the external token permit call.
Permit authorization depends on the untrusted block.timestamp deadline comparison.
The ensure(deadline) modifier compares the untrusted block.timestamp with the caller deadline.
The factory state variable is the delegatecall target of SushiYieldToken.mint.
The factory state variable is the delegatecall target of SushiYieldToken.burn.
lpToken balanceOf determines the amount minted in SushiYieldToken.mint.
Stored token data is embedded into the delegatecall payload of mint.
The owner nonce is consumed when building the digest passed to ecrecover.
DOMAIN_SEPARATOR is part of the signed digest that authorizes the permit.
The allowance mapping is read and reduced in transferFrom.
balanceOf is credited in _mint.
balanceOf is debited in _burn.
totalSupply is increased in _mint.
totalSupply is decreased in _burn.
The unlocked guard gates SushiYieldToken.mint through the lock modifier.
The unlocked guard gates SushiYieldToken.burn through the lock modifier.
The to parameter is the credited account of _mint.
The value parameter is added to totalSupply and balanceOf in _mint.
The owner parameter is part of the permit digest computation.
The deadline parameter is compared with block.timestamp in permit.
The v, r, s signature components are supplied directly to ecrecover.
The recovered address is the output compared against the claimed owner.
The digest local is the message hash passed to ecrecover.
The spender parameter receives the approval in approve.
The value parameter is written into the allowance mapping.
The pid parameter selects the yield token in _getYieldToken.
The amount parameter flows from SousChef.deposit into _deposit.
The to parameter of SousChef.deposit is the mint recipient.
The resolved yieldToken local comes from _getYieldToken.
The lpToken local is read from the yield token and transferred in _deposit.
The success local holds the delegatecall return flag of mint.
The success local holds the delegatecall return flag of burn.
The amount local is the computed LP token balance inside mint.
The from parameter is debited in transferFrom.
The value parameter is the amount transferred in transferFrom.
The ensure modifier guards depositWithPermit with the caller supplied deadline.
symbol0 is used to build name and symbol during initialize.
symbol1 is used to build name and symbol during initialize.
SousChef.deposit forwards execution to _deposit.
SousChef.deposit resolves the yield token through _getYieldToken.
SousChef.withdraw forwards execution to _withdraw.
SousChef.withdraw resolves the yield token through _getYieldToken.
depositWithPermit performs the permit step through _permit.
depositWithPermit performs the deposit step through _deposit.
_deposit makes a low-level external token call via TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom to a caller supplied LP token before state is finalized.
_deposit calls SushiYieldToken.mint, which itself delegatecalls the factory while SousChef holds no reentrancy guard.
_withdraw calls SushiYieldToken.burn, which performs a delegatecall to the factory with no SousChef level lock.
_withdraw makes an external token call via TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom to an attacker controlled token address.
mint executes the unsafe factory delegatecall while holding the lock guard.
burn executes the unsafe factory delegatecall.
The delegatecall executes factory controlled code in the storage context of the yield token.
The delegatecall executes factory controlled code in the storage context of the yield token.
permit authorization is derived from the ecrecover result.
The recovered and verified owner authorizes the _approve call.
transferFrom delegates to _transfer.
approve delegates to _approve.
transfer delegates to _transfer.
permit sets the allowance through _approve after validation.
_permit invokes an external permit call on an untrusted token address supplied by the caller.
_approve writes the allowance mapping.
_transfer updates the balanceOf mapping.
SushiYieldToken.mint performs the internal _mint after the delegatecall succeeds.
SushiYieldToken.burn performs the internal _burn after the delegatecall succeeds.
initialize performs external calls to pair.token0() and pair.token1() symbol() on caller supplied addresses.
The factory delegatecall inside mint may reenter the mint/burn flows since it executes with the token storage.
The factory delegatecall inside burn may reenter the burn/mint flows.

normalization_plan.reason: The to parameter is only meaningful inside SushiYieldToken._mint where the balance is credited.
The value parameter is consumed by the arithmetic of SushiYieldToken._mint.
The owner parameter is consumed by the digest construction of SushiYieldToken.permit.
The deadline parameter is consumed by the block.timestamp check in SushiYieldToken.permit.
The v, r, s parameters feed directly into the ecrecover unsafe operation.
The recoveredAddress local is the direct result of the ecrecover unsafe operation.
The digest local is the input hash to the ecrecover unsafe operation.
The spender parameter is consumed by SushiYieldToken.approve.
The value parameter is consumed by SushiYieldToken.approve.
The pid parameter is consumed by SousChef._getYieldToken.
The amount parameter is consumed by SousChef.deposit before being forwarded.
The to parameter is consumed by SousChef.deposit as the mint recipient.
The yieldToken local is produced by SousChef._getYieldToken.
The lpToken local is only used inside SousChef._deposit.
The success local is the return flag of the factory delegatecall in mint.
The success local is the return flag of the factory delegatecall in burn.
The amount local is the mint amount computed in SushiYieldToken.mint.
The from parameter is consumed by SushiYieldToken.transferFrom.
The value parameter is consumed by SushiYieldToken.transferFrom.
The deadline parameter is consumed by the ensure modifier guarding SousChef.depositWithPermit.
The symbol0 local is only used to build the name and symbol in SushiYieldToken.initialize.
The symbol1 local is only used to build the name and symbol in SushiYieldToken.initialize.
